lines.h1: Goblin Tools or Tiimo? Here's the answer in ten seconds.
lines.h2: Stuck on one task right now? Goblin Tools. Type it, and get small steps in seconds.
lines.h3: Need to see the shape of your whole day? Tiimo.
lines.h4: Now, five rounds to prove it. Plus one bonus round, where a third app comes in.
lines.r1a: Round one. Breaking down a stuck task.
lines.r1b: We typed clean the kitchen into Goblin's Magic To Do. No account, no setup, and the steps showed up in seconds.
lines.r1c: Tiimo's Co-planner can split tasks into steps too, but it asks you to plan your day first.
lines.r1d: For one stuck task, less in the way wins. Round to Goblin Tools.
lines.r2a: Round two. Planning your whole day.
lines.r2b: Tiimo puts your tasks on a color-coded timeline with icons, so you can see the shape of the day.
lines.r2c: Goblin Tools has no calendar or timeline at all.
lines.r3b: Tiimo has a calm focus timer, and widgets that keep it on your home or lock screen.
lines.r3c: Goblin Tools has no countdown. Its Taskmaster tool keeps one task on screen.
lines.r4a: Round four. Setup before you start.
lines.r4b: Goblin Tools needs none. Open the site and type.
lines.r4c: Tiimo asks for some setup. You build your day first.
lines.r4d: If setup is the thing you avoid, round to Goblin Tools.
lines.r5b: Tiimo builds routines and reminders, and syncs with Apple Calendar and Reminders.
lines.r5c: Goblin Tools doesn't do routines or reminders. Round to Tiimo.
lines.sc: Three rounds to two for Tiimo. But if you're stuck on one task right now, Goblin wins the round that matters.
lines.b1: One more round. You have the steps, and you still freeze.
lines.b2: Goblin hands you a list, and then you're on your own. Tiimo starts from planning your day.
lines.f1: Full disclosure, that's the gap we built FOCO for. It starts from the task you're putting off.
lines.f2: It breaks the task into tiny steps, each with a time estimate.
lines.f3: Then the task opens into a focus session, with a timer and a companion working next to you.
lines.o1: So. Goblin Tools when one task is stuck right now. Tiimo when your whole day needs a shape.
lines.o2: And FOCO when you have the steps, but still can't begin. Tell me in the comments which one you are.
